summary.en: Israel has intensified airstrikes and artillery against Hezbollah sites in southern Lebanon, including a deep strike on a Hezbollah stronghold, attacks on four districts that caused fires and damage, and the occupation of Haddatha under a cease-fire. Hezbollah has responded with guerrilla tactics and drone warfare while facing domestic crackdowns, with five members charged with recruiting and arming others and sanctions placed on a charity and gold companies linked to the group. European states are pushing to replace UN peacekeepers as UNIFIL prepares to exit, and the UN Security Council endorsed the mission without naming a successor. The conflict caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel har økt luftangrep og artilleri mot Hizbollah-mål i sørlige Libanon, inkludert et dypt angrep på en Hizbollah-festning, angrep på fire distrikter som forårsaket branner og skader, og okkupasjonen av Haddatha under en våpenhvile. Hizbollah har svart med geriljataktikk og dronekamp mens den møter innenlandske nedslag, med fem medlemmer tiltalt for rekruttering og bearming av andre og sanksjoner mot en veldedighet og gullbedrifter knyttet til gruppen. Europeiske stater presser på for å erstatte FN fredsbevarere mens UNIFIL forbereder seg på å trekke seg tilbake, og FN sikkerhetsråd støttet oppdraget uten å navngi en etterfølger. Konflikten førte til 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
